plan.gap: No source examined provides direct methodological guidance on soil moisture sensor placement, installation depth, spatial distribution pattern, or decision thresholds for alfalfa. All reviewed sources address harvesting, nutrition, pest, or winter-dormancy topics, leaving the sensor methodology gap unaddressed.
queries: alfalfa soil moisture sensor placement depth TDR FDR university extension
alfalfa irrigation scheduling soil moisture sensor network depth spacing peer-reviewed

requirements.need: Concrete evidence on where and how deep soil moisture sensors are installed in alfalfa fields — sensor type (TDR, FDR/capacitance, neutron probe), number per field, spatial distribution pattern, and installation protocol — from a university extension or peer-reviewed primary source.

Measured or recommended soil moisture threshold values (volumetric water content or tension) for alfalfa irrigation scheduling decisions, with original units (cSt, MPa, % θv, etc.) and geographic/source context; must not be inferred from unrelated crops.

Evidence explicitly tied to alfalfa (Medicago sativa) crop stage and growing system — not generalized sensor placement guidance — to confirm relevance for Persian-language alfalfa field monitoring context.
